c-d3806cf8d52d7ab7.texto: Maskith, here rendered “image,” is in Numbers 33:52 (where the word is in the plural) translated “pictures.” Some writers suppose that eben maskith, “figure stone,” is a stone formed into a figure; that is, an idol of stone in distinction to one made of iron or of wood. See Keil,…

c-ddf72ea7ab5606f0.texto: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images.

h-f5f77e85f7bd3995.texto: Dado en el Sinaí, dentro del primer año tras el éxodo (fecha temprana). Sin introducción propia de JFB ni Poole en el repositorio.
